import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 7100;
    static final long INF = 1000000000L;
    static DinicFlow mf = new DinicFlow();
    static char[][] g1 = new char[14][14];
    static char[][] g2 = new char[14][14];
    static boolean[][] seen = new boolean[14][14];
    static int[][] d = new int[14][14];
    static int n;
    static int[] tgt = new int[103];

    static class DinicFlow {
        static class Edge {
            int from, to;
            long flow, cap;
            Edge(int from, int to, long flow, long cap) {
                this.from = from;
                this.to = to;
                this.flow = flow;
                this.cap = cap;
            }
        }

        int S, T;
        ArrayList<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[MAX_SIZE];
        int[] level = new int[MAX_SIZE];
        int[] vis = new int[MAX_SIZE];
        int[] ptr = new int[MAX_SIZE];

        DinicFlow() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void init() {
            edges.clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; i++) adj[i].clear();
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            edges.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, cap));
            edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
            adj[u].add(edges.size() - 2);
            adj[v].add(edges.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(vis, 0);
            Arrays.fill(level, 0);
            Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
            q.add(S);
            vis[S] = 1;
            level[S] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (int idx : adj[v]) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(idx);
                    if (vis[e.to] == 0 && e.cap > e.flow) {
                        level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                        vis[e.to] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            return vis[T] == 1;
        }

        long dfs(int v, long flow) {
            if (v == T || flow == 0) return flow;
            long pushed = 0;
            int i = ptr[v];
            while (i < adj[v].size()) {
                Edge e = edges.get(adj[v].get(i));
                if (level[v] + 1 == level[e.to]) {
                    long minf = Math.min(flow, e.cap - e.flow);
                    long add = dfs(e.to, minf);
                    if (add > 0) {
                        e.flow += add;
                        edges.get(adj[v].get(i) ^ 1).flow -= add;
                        pushed += add;
                        flow -= add;
                        if (flow == 0) {
                            ptr[v] = i;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                i++;
                ptr[v] = i;
            }
            return pushed;
        }

        long maxFlow() {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                flow += dfs(S, INF);
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static void BFS(int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(d[i], 111);
            Arrays.fill(seen[i], false);
        }
        d[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy, 0});
        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int cx = cur[0], cy = cur[1];
            if (seen[cx][cy]) continue;
            seen[cx][cy] = true;
            d[cx][cy] = cur[2];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = cx + dx[i], ny = cy + dy[i];
                if (nx < 1 || nx > n || ny < 1 || ny > n || seen[nx][ny] || g1[nx][ny] == 'Y') continue;
                q.add(new int[]{nx, ny, cur[2] + 1});
            }
        }
    }

    static int idx(int l, int x, int y) {
        return l * n * n + (x - 1) * n + y;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                g1[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                g2[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }

        mf.S = 0;
        mf.T = MAX_SIZE - 2;
        int sx = 0, sy = 0;
        outer:
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (g1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                    break outer;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n * n; i++) {
            tgt[i] = MAX_SIZE - 3 - (n * n - i);
        }

        BFS(sx, sy);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(g1[i][j])) {
                    mf.addEdge(mf.S, idx(0, i, j), g1[i][j] - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(g2[i][j])) {
                    mf.addEdge(tgt[idx(0, i, j)], mf.T, g2[i][j] - '0');
                }
                mf.addEdge(idx(0, i, j), tgt[idx(0, i, j)], INF);
            }
        }

        int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};
        for (int i = 1; i <= t; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    if (g1[j][k] == 'Y' || g1[j][k] == 'Z') continue;
                    for (int l = 0; l < 4; l++) {
                        int tx = dx[l] + j, ty = dy[l] + k;
                        if (tx >= 1 && tx <= n && ty >= 1 && ty <= n && g1[tx][ty] != 'Y' && g1[tx][ty] != 'Z') {
                            if (d[j][k] >= i && d[tx][ty] >= i && g1[j][k] != 'Y' && g1[j][k] != 'Z') {
                                mf.addEdge(idx(i - 1, tx, ty), idx(i, j, k), INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    mf.addEdge(idx(i, j, k), tgt[idx(0, j, k)], INF);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(mf.maxFlow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
